title: Fixed-window Dynamic Mode Decomposition residual

paper.title: Dynamic mode decomposition of numerical and experimental data

hypothesis: A fixed-window linear evolution operator can expose locally unexplained dynamics as a diagnostic residual.
causalBoundary: The operator at t is fitted only on a trailing window ending at t-1, and the current observation is used only to form the residual.
counterfactual: A stable linear synthetic process should produce smaller residuals than a deliberately perturbed continuation under the same frozen window.
